contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed footer total ($13,446.74 on p162), equal to the cover's 'Totals for This Report' cell ($13,446.74)
contributions.detail: 27 Form A rows sum to 13,446.74 exactly = the schedule's printed footer total = the cover's This-Report column. The cover's Cumulative cell is 73,827.00 and its Totals-from-Last-Report cell is 60,380.26 (73,827.00 - 60,380.26 = 13,446.74), so this December-5 FINAL report's schedule is PERIOD-scoped behind a cumulative cover: the 60,380.26 raised in earlier 2024 periods is not itemized on this document. No figure was synthesized by differencing covers - the This-Report cell is printed on this filing's own cover. 2024 is the 3-line variant, so there is no separate <=$50 aggregate line. No in-kind rows are labelled on this schedule, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions coincide.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed footer total (-18686.9 on p164), equal to the cover's 'Totals for This Report' cell (($18,686.90))
expenditures.detail: 44 Form B rows (40 on p163 + 4 on p164) sum to -18,686.90 exactly (p163 -17,745.76 + p164 -941.14) = the schedule's printed footer total = the cover's This-Report column. Cumulative is (69,825.62) with (51,138.72) from the last report, so the schedule is period-scoped. NOTE ON SIGN: this filer prints every expenditure as a NEGATIVE number and the cover prints all three expenditure cells in red accounting parentheses; the printed signs are kept verbatim (brief section 6: an accounting-parenthesised negative stays negative), so this side's stored sum is negative while the module's published stated_total_expenditures is the same magnitude unsigned.

SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: these archive pages have a 2550 x 3300 POINT mediabox (35.4 x 45.8 inches), and make_snippet.py --dpi 900 returns a BLANK crop on them (poppler gives up on the implied ~1.3 gigapixel page); the same geometry at --dpi 400 renders cleanly and is already ~1,500 px across a cell. Use 300-400 dpi on this 2024 combined archive, not 900.

itemized.notes: Typed (not handwritten) 2024 3-line final report; p161 cover, p162 Form A, p163-164 Form B. Form A prints separate City / State / Zip columns and they are carried as donor_city/donor_state; street addresses and PO boxes are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY: city/state only). Form B's City column is carried verbatim as vendor_city, including its non-city values ('ONLINE', 'SALT LAKE'). The filer writes expenditures as negative numbers throughout, including the schedule footer total (-18686.9) and all three cover cells (in red parentheses); signs are kept verbatim. Row 8 of Form A is clipped by its own column border and reads 'UTAH DONOR COLLABORATIV'; it is kept exactly as printed. Two purposes are misspelled by the filer ('NEWSPAPAER', 'TIBITS AND FRIENDS') and are kept verbatim. The cover's December-5 checkbox text contains the county's own stale year ('through December 31, 2022' on a 2024 form) - a form-template defect, noted, not corrected.
